Class SelectTotemCommand

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.lobby.SelectTotemCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerCommand
public class SelectTotemCommand extends Object implements ServerCommand
Client request that confirms a totem selection in a pending lobby. Deserialized by Jackson from {"action":"SELECT_TOTEM",...}.
